mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hypervisor_resource( hypervisor_id, status, availability_zone, traits, total_vcpu, total_memory_gb, total_gpu, resource_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{hypervisorId}, 'MAINTENANCE', #{availabilityZone}, '[]', #{totalVcpu}, #{totalMemoryGb}, #{totalGpu}, #{version}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE availability_zone = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(availability_zone), availability_zone), total_vcpu = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_vcpu), total_vcpu), total_memory_gb = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_memory_gb), total_memory_gb), total_gpu = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_gpu), total_gpu), updated_at = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), resource_version = GREATEST(resource_version, VALUES(resource_version))
mapper.update: UPDATE hypervisor_resource SET reserved_vcpu = reserved_vcpu + #{reservedVcpuDelta}, allocated_vcpu = allocated_vcpu + #{allocatedVcpuDelta}, reserved_memory_gb = reserved_memory_gb + #{reservedMemoryGbDelta}, allocated_memory_gb = allocated_memory_gb + #{allocatedMemoryGbDelta}, reserved_gpu = reserved_gpu + #{reservedGpuDelta}, allocated_gpu = allocated_gpu + #{allocatedGpuDelta}, resource_version = #{version}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE hypervisor_id = #{hypervisorId} AND resource_version < #{version}
UPDATE hypervisor_host SET hypervisor_status = #{status}, expected_maintenance_time = COALESCE(#{expectedMaintenanceTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, expected_maintenance_time) WHERE id = #{hypervisorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instance_allocation( instance_id, hypervisor_id, reservation_id, vcpus, memory_gb, gpu_count, allocation_status, resource_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{hypervisorId}, #{reservationId}, #{vcpus}, #{memoryGb}, #{gpuCount}, 'ALLOCATED', #{version}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE allocation_status = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), 'ALLOCATED', allocation_status), updated_at = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), resource_version = GREATEST(resource_version, VALUES(resource_version))
